title: CAD mesher M1 independent fixture expectation v1
description: Hand-derived expected inventory projection for one fixture. This document is an oracle input and must not be emitted by the production classifier under test.

subject_id.description: A fixture-local deterministic dotted ID or a public StableId.

subject_id_list.x-canonical-order: ascending fixture-local ID, or StableId numeric kind tag then ordinal

point3.x-canonical-order: fixed x, y, z component order

code_list.x-canonical-order: semantic order declared by the owning evidence field

number_grid.x-canonical-order: outer u index then inner v index

point3_grid.x-canonical-order: outer u index then inner v index

parameter_domains.x-canonical-order: axis order curve, or u then v

child_ids.x-canonical-order: semantic topological child order with deterministic ID tie-break

relations.x-canonical-order: ascending relation code, semantic ordinal, then target ID

coedge_ids.x-canonical-order: semantic oriented traversal order within the wire

seam_unwrap_offsets.x-canonical-order: same semantic oriented traversal order as coedge_ids

loops.x-canonical-order: ascending nesting depth, role outer before inner, then loop ID

axes.x-canonical-order: axis order curve, or u then v

observation_list.x-canonical-order: ascending observation kind then observation id

orientation_states.x-canonical-order: FORWARD, REVERSED, INTERNAL, EXTERNAL when present

validation_findings.x-canonical-order: ascending finding code then subject kind
